answer_1.quote: We perform our experiment on the OPT and LLAMA base models on MMLU, Hellaswag, and Chatbot Arena datasets... For MMLU, we use the standard 5-shot setup... For Hellaswag, we feed the model with incomplete sentences without the choices... We found results are very similar for other datasets, such as Chatbot Arena...

answer_2.quote: We measure throughput (tokens generated per second) and TAR... The accuracy numbers are obtained from OpenLLM Leaderboard (HuggingFace, 2023)...
